nodes.label: Photo upload added
nodes.line: Each recipe page got an Upload photo button, with the photo shown at the top of the recipe and 4 new tests.

evidence.quote: Photo upload is in. Each recipe page now has an Upload photo button, and the photo shows at the top of the recipe.

nodes.label: Phone photos upload fine
nodes.line: Photos from your phone failed until two 1 MB limits, the web server's and the app's own, went up to 10 MB.

story.basis: first failed upload to the working one

steps.text: Photos from your phone failed with Upload failed; small test images worked.
Raised the web server's limit, then the app's own 1 MB cap, to 10 MB.
A 6 MB photo from your phone uploaded fine.

evidence.quote: Uploading a photo from my phone fails.
Found a second limit: the app itself also capped uploads at 1 MB.
Works now. A 6 MB photo from my phone uploaded fine.

nodes.label: Phones store photo rotation separately
nodes.line: Phones save the rotation as a separate tag instead of turning the pixels, and the page ignored it, so photos showed sideways.

evidence.quote: Phones save the rotation as a separate tag instead of turning the pixels, and the page ignored that tag.

nodes.label: Photos show the right way up
nodes.line: Each photo is now turned the right way up when it is uploaded, and you checked it.

evidence.quote: I now turn each photo the right way up when it is uploaded.
Perfect, it's the right way up now.

open.label: Storage keys from Sam
open.line: Sam said he would send the keys for the photo storage bucket this week; until then photos stay on the server's disk.

evidence.quote: Sam has the keys for the photo storage bucket. I asked him this morning and he said he'd send them this week.

open.label: Lena's feedback on the photo layout
open.line: Lena is checking the new photo layout on her phone, and the release waits for her feedback.

evidence.quote: Lena is checking the new photo layout on her phone. I'll wait for her feedback before the release.

open.label: Release photo upload
open.line: The release with photo upload waits for Lena's feedback on the layout.

evidence.quote: I'll wait for her feedback before the release.
Got it: the release waits for Lena's feedback on the layout.

open.label: Shrink photos after the launch
open.line: You put off shrinking photos before they are saved until after the launch.

evidence.quote: Shrinking photos before saving would be nice, but let's leave that until after the launch.

open.label: Sign up for the meetup demo
open.line: You want to demo recipe-box at the web meetup on September 20 and planned to sign up for a slot this week.

evidence.quote: I want to demo recipe-box at the web meetup on September 20. I'll sign up for a demo slot this week.

open.label: Delete a recipe's photo with it
open.line: Deleting a recipe should also delete its photo; it is not done yet.

evidence.quote: deleting a recipe should delete its photo too.

gist: You added photo upload to recipe-box and got phone photos uploading and showing the right way up; deleting a recipe's photo and the release are still open.
